reasoning: This repo builds the ODH/RHOAI distribution container image (quay.io/opendatahub/odh-ogx-core) for the upstream OGX server. It has no application source of its own. It holds a provider manifest (build/build.yaml), generators for the runtime config.yaml and Containerfile, lock files, and Konflux/Tekton build definitions. What it ships is a long-running API server: the image runs the OGX server on port 8321 and serves OpenAI-compatible inference, models, responses, vector stores and file-processor endpoints. The functional tests (Bruno collections) and integration workflows exercise those endpoints. It contains no CRDs or controllers, so it is not an operator, and it is not consumed as an importable library. The repo's own content is mostly packaging and configuration, but the component it adds to the platform is a deployable service, so 'service' is the best fit.
